svg.title: BCBC 2024 · 9.10.1.4 Items under Part 6 Jurisdiction
svg.text: BCBC 2024 · DIVISION B · PART 9 HOUSING AND SMALL BUILDINGS · SECTION 9.10 FIRE PROTECTION
Items under Part 6 Jurisdiction

g.text: family use: NFPA 96 does not apply (Note)

svg.text: WHAT THE CODE REQUIRES
In kitchens containing commercial cooking
equipment used in processes producing
grease-laden vapours, the equipment is
designed and installed in conformance with
Article 6.3.1.6.
Part 6 refers to NFPA 96, "Standard for
Ventilation Control and Fire Protection of
Commercial Cooking Operations". The deciding
factor is the potential for production of
grease-laden vapours and smoke, rather than the
type of equipment used. NFPA 96 does not apply to
domestic equipment for normal residential family
use, but it should apply to domestic equipment
used in commercial, industrial, institutional and
similar cooking applications where that potential
exceeds normal residential family use.
Drawn: two kitchens, walls cut low. Grey dashes: cooking vapours. Equipment shown is illustration only.
Source: BCBC 2024, Division B, Article 9.10.1.4. (page 9-59)
